description_en: Queries the details of waiting room events
description_zh: 查询等候室的等候室事件详情
name: ListWaitingRoomEvents

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The waiting room ID, which is used to identify a specific waiting room. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850279.html operation to obtain the waiting room ID
parameters.help_zh: 等候室ID，用于标识特定的等候室。可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850279.html接口获取
parameters.name: waiting_room_id

parameters.help_en: The waiting room event ID. This parameter is optional and is used to query a specific waiting room event
parameters.help_zh: 等候室事件ID，可选参数，用于查询特定等候室事件
parameters.name: waiting_room_event_id

RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，用于追踪调用情况

WaitingRoomEvents.description_en: The list of waiting room events, which contains the specific information of each event
WaitingRoomEvents.description_zh: 等候室事件列表，包含每个事件的具体信息

items.description_en: The details of the waiting room event

CustomPageHtml.description_en: The custom content of the waiting room page. This parameter is required when the waiting room type is custom. The content must be URL-encoded
CustomPageHtml.description_zh: 用户自定义等候室页面内容，当等候室类型为自定义类型时，需要传入。传入的内容需要经过URL编码

Description.description_en: The detailed description of the event

DisableSessionRenewalEnable.description_en:
Specifies whether session renewal is disabled. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
DisableSessionRenewalEnable.description_zh:
禁用会话续订。支持：
on：开启。
off：关闭

Enable.description_en:
The enabled status of the event. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
Enable.description_zh:
事件启用状态。
on ：表示启用。
off：表示禁用

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the event. The value is a UNIX timestamp

JsonResponseEnable.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable JSON responses. If this feature is enabled and the Accept request header contains "application/json", JSON data is returned. Valid values:

on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
JsonResponseEnable.description_zh:
JSON响应。开启后accept请求头包含"application/json"会返回JSON数据。取值：

on：开启。
off：关闭

Language.description_en:
The language of the waiting room page. This parameter is required when the waiting room type is default. Valid values:

enus: English.
zhcn: Simplified Chinese.
zhhk: Traditional Chinese
Language.description_zh:
等候室页面的语言，当等候室类型为默认类型时，需要传入。支持以下类型：

enus：英文。
zhcn：中文简体。
zhhk：中文繁体

Name.description_en: The event name, which is a custom event description
Name.description_zh: 事件名称，自定义的事件描述

NewUsersPerMinute.description_en: The number of new users per minute

PreQueueEnable.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable pre-queuing. Valid values:

on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
PreQueueEnable.description_zh:
预排队开关。

on：开启。
off：关闭

PreQueueStartTime.description_en: The start time of pre-queuing. The value is a UNIX timestamp. This parameter is valid only when pre-queuing is enabled
PreQueueStartTime.description_zh: 预排队开始时间（Unix时间戳），若开启预排队功能则有效

QueuingMethod.description_en:
The queuing method. Valid values:

random: Random.
fifo: First-in, first-out (FIFO).
passthrough: Passthrough.
reject-all: Reject all
QueuingMethod.description_zh:
排队方式。取值：

random：随机。
fifo：先进先出。
passthrough：直通。
reject-all：拒绝全部

QueuingStatusCode.description_en:
The waiting room status code. Valid values:

200
202
429

RandomPreQueueEnable.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable random pre-queuing. Valid values:

on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
RandomPreQueueEnable.description_zh:
随机排队开关。

on：开启。
off：关闭

SessionDuration.description_zh: 会话持续时间（单位：分钟）

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the event. The value is a UNIX timestamp

TotalActiveUsers.description_en: The total number of active users

WaitingRoomEventId.description_en: The event ID, which uniquely identifies a waiting room event
WaitingRoomEventId.description_zh: 事件ID，唯一标识一个等候室事件

WaitingRoomId.description_en: The ID of the associated waiting room

WaitingRoomType.description_en:
The waiting room type. Valid values:

default: Default type.
custom: Custom type
WaitingRoomType.description_zh:
等候室类型。支持以下类型：

default：默认类型。
custom：自定义类型
